mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam can impair renal function and increase empagliflozin concentrations; empagliflozin increases risk of genital infections and diabetic ketoacidosis which may be exacerbated during serious infections requiring beta-lactam therapy.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, and monitor for signs of diabetic ketoacidosis or genital infections; consider alternative antibiotic if renal function deteriorates.
